items.title: Sputnik 1 launched
items.description: First artificial satellite placed in orbit by the Soviet Union

items.title: Voyager 1 launched
items.description: NASA probe begins its journey to the outer planets and beyond the solar system

items.title: ISS construction begins
items.description: International Space Station assembly starts in orbit

fact: These four milestones trace the first 40 years of human spaceflight, from the first satellite to a probe leaving the solar system and a continuously inhabited orbital outpost.
